scene.noWebglHint: Enable hardware acceleration or try another browser.
scene.contextLost: The graphics context was lost (the GPU was reset or ran out of memory).
scene.flatHint: This session's data has no reliable altitude.
scene.separationHint: Spreads cars running together across the track (visual only).

estimated.hintUnknown: This value does not come from the source as is: it has been derived.

hints.elevation: Track height is multiplied so the elevation change is visible: it is not the real one.
hints.separation: Cars running together are spread across the track so you can tell them apart. There is no lateral data: their real position is the centre line.
hints.lap1: Live timing does not give the lap 1 time in a race. It is computed as the line crossing minus the start time, so it includes the run from the grid.
hints.positions: The source has no sampled positions for this session: they have been reconstructed from other data.
hints.telemetry: Telemetry for this session has been reconstructed from other data, it does not come from the source as is.
hints.trackStatus: No official track status: flags and neutralisations are inferred from race control messages.
